newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China '97 trade surplus at $22.9 bln.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China '97 trade surplus at $22.9 bln.

text.p: China will have a trade surplus of $22.9 billion this year compared with $12.228 billion last year, the China Securities said on Tuesday.
It quoted the State Information Centre, a government think-tank, as making the forecast.
Imports would be $152.7 billion, up 10 percent from 1996, the newspaper said without giving further details.
The trade forecast for the full year included a slightly underestimated surplus for the first half of 1997.
The think-tank estimated China's first-half trade surplus would be $14.0 billion but state media reported on Monday that the actual surplus for the period was $17.77 billion.
